en.headline: MTR passenger’s hand trapped in train door while retrieving item from tracks
en.dek: A man suffered finger injuries on a Tseung Kwan O Line train after attempting to pick up a dropped phone near Tiu Keng Leng; the train returned to the station and staff recovered the item.
body: The MTR Corporation confirmed that a passenger’s hand was caught in a train door on Friday night after he tried to retrieve an item that had fallen onto the tracks. The incident occurred around 10pm on a train that had just left Tiu Keng Leng station bound for Po Lam on the Tseung Kwan O Line.

According to the operator, another passenger activated the emergency intercom. The train captain arranged for the train to return to Tiu Keng Leng, where station staff assisted and called an ambulance. The passenger, reported as a man in his 50s, sustained injuries to three fingers and was taken to Tseung Kwan O Hospital. Staff later recovered the dropped item from the track area and returned it to him.

The MTR reminded passengers not to attempt to retrieve objects that fall into the gap between the train and platform. They should notify station staff immediately so that assistance can be provided under safe conditions.

zh.headline: 港鐵乘客執路軌物品遭車門夾手 三指受傷送院
zh.dek: 一名男子周五晚在調景嶺站開出的將軍澳綫列車上，疑因手機跌落路軌伸手拾取時被車門夾住手指，列車折返車站後由救護車送院。
body: 港鐵公司證實，周五晚上約10時，一列剛由調景嶺站開出前往寶琳的將軍澳綫列車上，有乘客的手部被車門夾住。事主疑因個人物品跌落路軌而嘗試拾取。
另一名乘客按動緊急通話器通知車長，車長隨即安排列車返回調景嶺站。車站職員到月台協助並召喚救護車，事主三指受傷，清醒送往將軍澳醫院治理。職員其後安排人員到路軌拾回物品並交還物主。
港鐵提醒乘客，如物品不慎跌入列車與月台之間的罅隙，切勿自行嘗試拾取，應即時通知車站職員，職員會在確保安全的情况下提供協助。
